ar: سالت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) عن عظام الفيل مداهنها و امشاطها قال لا باس بها .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibrahim Bin Mihzam, from Al Qasim Bin Al Waleed who said,  ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the bones of the elephants, and their oils, and their combs. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with it’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) تقليم الاظفار يمنع الداء الاعظم و يدر الرزق .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid who said,  ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Trimming the nails prevents the grievous illness and bring the livelihood’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: تقليم الاظفار يوم الجمعه يومن من الجذام و البرص و العمي و ان لم تحتج فحكها .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Trimming the nails on the day of Friday is a safety from the leprosy, and the vitiligo, and the blindness, and if you do not need to, so file it’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قال لي ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) خذ من شاربك و اظفارك في كل جمعه فان لم يكن فيها شي‏ء فحكها لا يصيبك جنون و لا جذام و لا برص .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Al Hassan Bin Suleyman, from his uncle Abdullah Bin Hilal who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said to me: ‘Take (pluck) from your moustache and (cut) your nails during every Friday, so if there does not happen to be anything in these, so file it, and neither will insanity hit you, nor leprosy, nor vitiligo’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: تقليم الاظفار و اخذ الشارب في كل جمعه امان من البرص و الجنون .
en: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Trimming the nails, and taking (plucking) the moustache during every Friday is a safety from the vitiligo and the insanity’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: من السنه تقليم الاظفار .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ibn Uqba, from his father,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘From the Sunnah is the trimming of the nails’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: انما قص الاظفار لانها مقيل الشيطان و منه يكون النسيان .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from the one who mentioned it, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr, from Abu Hama,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘But rather, clip the nails because these are a resting-place for the Satanla, and from it happens the forgetfulness’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: ان استر و اخفي ما يسلط الشيطان من ابن ادم ان صار ان يسكن تحت الاظافير .
en: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al Hakam Bin Miskeyn, from Huzayfa Bin Mansour,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The most veiled and most concealed (place) from where the Satanla overcomes a son of Adamas is that hela settles underneath the nails’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قلت له ما ثواب من اخذ من شاربه و قلم اظفاره في كل جمعه قال لا يزال مطهرا الي الجمعه الاخري .
en: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ali Al Hannat, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala, from Abu Baseer,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘What is a Reward for the one who takes (trims) from his moustache, and trims his nails during every Friday?’ Heasws said: ‘He would not cease to be clean up to the other Friday’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قال ابو جعفر ( عليه السلام ) من اخذ من اظفاره و شاربه كل جمعه و قال حين ياخذ بسم الله و بالله و علي سنه محمد رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) لم يسقط منه قلامه و لا جزازه الا كتب الله له بها عتق نسمه و لا يمرض الا مرضه الذي يموت فيه .
en: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Hafs Al Jarjany, from Abu Al Khazeyb Al Rabie Bin Bakr Al Azdy, from Abdul Rahim al Qaseyr who said,  ‘Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘The one who takes from his nails and his moustache, every Friday, and says when he takes, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj and with Allahazwj, and upon Sunnah of Muhammadsaww, Rasool-Allahsaww’, there will not fall off from him, nether a clipping nor a trimming except that Allahazwj would Write for him, due to it, an emancipation of a person, and he would not fall sick except for the sickness in which he would be dying’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) تقليم الاظفار و قص الشارب و غسل الراس بالخطمي كل جمعه ينفي الفقر و يزيد في الرزق .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Talha who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Trimming of the nails and clipping of the moustache, and washing of the head with the hibiscus (plant) every Friday negates the poverty and increase in the livelihood’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قال رجل لعبد الله بن الحسن علمني شييا في الرزق فقال الزم مصلاك اذا صليت الفجر الي طلوع الشمس فانه انجع في طلب الرزق من الضرب في الارض فاخبرت بذلك ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) فقال ا لا اعلمك في الرزق ما هو انفع من ذلك قال قلت بلي قال خذ من شاربك و اظفارك كل جمعه .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Uqba, from Abu Kahmas who said,  ‘A man said to Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan, ‘Teach me something regarding the sustenance’. So he said, ‘Necessitate upon yourself to stay in your Prayer mat when you have Prayed Al-Fajr, up to the emergence of the sun, for it is more beneficial in the seeking of the livelihood than the going about in the land, for I informed Abu Abdullahasws with that, so heasws said, ‘Shall Iasws teach you regarding the livelihood what is more beneficial than that?’ I said, ‘Yes’. Heasws said: ‘Take from your moustache and your nails, every Friday’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: اتيت عبد الله بن الحسن فقلت علمني دعاء في الرزق فقال قل اللهم تول امري و لا تول امري غيرك فعرضته علي ابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) فقال ا لا ادلك علي ما هو انفع من هذا في الرزق تقص اظافيرك و شاربك في كل جمعه و لو بحكها .
en: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from his father who said,  ‘I went over to Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan (Al-Basry), so I said, ‘Teach me a supplication regarding the livelihood. So he said, ‘Say, ‘O Allahazwj! Youazwj Handle my matters and do not let anyone other than Youazwj handle my matters’. So I presented it to Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws said: ‘Shall Iasws point you upon what is more beneficial than this regarding the livelihood? Clip your nails and your moustache during every Friday, even though it be by filing it’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: راني ابو الحسن ( عليه السلام ) بخراسان و انا اشتكي عيني فقال ا لا ادلك علي شي‏ء ان فعلته لم تشتك عينك فقلت بلي فقال خذ من اظفارك في كل خميس قال ففعلت فما اشتكيت عيني الي يوم اخبرتك .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Khalaf who said,  ‘Abu Al-Hassanasws saw me at Khurasan and I complained about my eyes. So heasws said: ‘Shall Iasws point you upon something that if you were to do it, you would not complain of your eyes?’ So I said, ‘Yes’. So heasws said: ‘Take from your nails during every Thursday’. So I did it, and I did not complain about my eyes up to the day that I am informing you’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: من ادمن اخذ اظفاره كل خميس لم ترمد عينه .
en: From him, from his father, from Abu Abdullah Bin Al Fazl Al Nowfaly, from his father, and his uncle, altogether,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The one who is habitual in taking his nails during every Thursday, would not have conjunctivitis of his eye’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) للرجال قصوا اظافيركم و للنساء اتركن فانه ازين لكن .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny who said,  ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said to the men: ‘Clip your nails’, and (said) to the women: ‘Leave them for it is an adornment for you’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: قص الاظفار تبدا بخنصر الايسر ثم تختم باليمين .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, raising it,  ‘(Heasws said): ‘With regards to clipping the nails, begin with the little finger of the left hand, then end with the little finger of the right hand’.

t: Chapter 38 – Clipping the Nails
ar: احتبس الوحي عن النبي ( صلي الله عليه واله ) فقيل له احتبس الوحي عنك فقال ( صلي الله عليه واله ) و كيف لا يحتبس و انتم لا تقلمون اظفاركم و لا تنقون رواجبكم .
en: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The Revelation was Withheld from the Prophetsaww, so it was said to himsaww, ‘The Revelation has been Withheld from yousaww’. So hesaww said: ‘And why should it not be Withheld and you all are not cutting your nails and are not cleaning your hands?’

t: Chapter 39 – Cutting the grey hair and plucking it
ar: لا باس بجز الشمط و نتفه و جزه احب الي من نتفه .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘There is no problem with cutting the grey hair and plucking it, and cutting it is more beloved to me than plucking it’.

t: Chapter 39 – Cutting the grey hair and plucking it
ar: لا باس بجز الشمط و نتفه من اللحيه .
en: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from the one who mentioned it,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘There is no problem with cutting the grey hair and plucking it from the beard’.

t: Chapter 39 – Cutting the grey hair and plucking it
ar: امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) كان لا يري بجز الشيب باسا و يكره نتفه .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws that Amir Al-Momineenasws did not view the cutting of the grey hairs as a problem, and disliked plucking it’.

t: Chapter 39 – Cutting the grey hair and plucking it
ar: ( عليه السلام ) اول من شاب ابراهيم ( عليه السلام ) فقال يا رب ما هذا فقال نور و توقير قال رب زدني منه .
en: And by this chain,  ‘Heasws said: ‘The first one to be grey-haired was Ibrahimas. Heas said: ‘O Lordazwj! What is this?’ So Heazwj Said: “A radiance and a reverence”. Heas said: ‘Lordazwj! Increase for meas, from it’.

t: Chapter 39 – Cutting the grey hair and plucking it
ar: كان الناس لا يشيبون فابصر ابراهيم ( عليه السلام ) شيبا في لحيته فقال يا رب ما هذا فقال هذا وقار فقال يا رب زدني وقارا .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The people were not becoming grey-haired. So Ibrahimas saw something in hisas beard, so heas said: ‘O Lordazwj! What is this?’ So Heazwj Said: “This is a reverence”. So heas said: ‘O Lordazwj! Increase the reverence for meas’’.

t: Chapter 39 – Cutting the grey hair and plucking it
ar: الشيب في مقدم الراس يمن و في العارضين سخاء و في الذوايب شجاعه و في القفا شوم .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Abu Ayoub Al Madainy, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary,  (It has been narrated) from Al-Rezaasws, from hisasws forefathersasws having said: ‘The grey hair in the front part of the head is a Blessing, and in the two sides is generosity, and in the top is courage, and in the back is inauspiciousness’.

t: Chapter 4 – The white clothes and the cotton
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) البسوا البياض فانه اطيب و اطهر و كفنوا فيه موتاكم .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Al Qaddah,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Wear the white for it is better and purer, and enshroud your deceased in it’.

t: Chapter 4 – The white clothes and the cotton
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) البسوا البياض فانه اطيب و اطهر و كفنوا فيه موتاكم .
en: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Musanna Al Hannat,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Wear the white, for it is better and cleaner, and enshroud your dead ones in it’.

t: Chapter 4 – The white clothes and the cotton
ar: حملت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) الحمله الثانيه الي الكوفه و ابو جعفر المنصور بها فلما اشرف علي الهاشميه مدينه ابي جعفر اخرج رجله من غرز الرجل ثم نزل و دعا ببغله شهباء و لبس ثياب بيض و كمه بيضاء فلما دخل عليه قال له ابو جعفر لقد تشبهت بالانبياء فقال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) و اني تبعدني من ابناء الانبياء فقال لقد هممت ان ابعث الي المدينه من يعقر نخلها و يسبي ذريتها فقال و لم ذلك يا امير المومنين فقال رفع الي ان مولاك المعلي بن خنيس يدعو اليك و يجمع لك الاموال فقال و الله ما كان فقال لست ارضي منك الا بالطلاق و العتاق و الهدي و المشي فقال ا بالانداد من دون الله تامرني ان احلف انه من لم يرض بالله فليس من الله في شي‏ء فقال ا تتفقه علي فقال و اني تبعدني من الفقه و انا ابن رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) فقال فاني اجمع بينك و بين من سعي بك قال فافعل فجاء الرجل الذي سعي به فقال له ابو عبد الله يا هذا فقال نعم و الله الذي لا اله الا هو عالم الغيب و الشهاده الرحمن الرحيم لقد فعلت فقال له ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) ويلك تمجد الله فيستحيي من تعذيبك و لكن قل بريت من حول الله و قوته و الجات الي حولي و قوتي فحلف بها الرجل فلم يستتمها حتي وقع ميتا فقال له ابو جعفر لا اصدق بعدها عليك ابدا و احسن جايزته و رده .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of his companions, from Safwan Al Jammal who said,  ‘I transported Abu Abdullahasws for the second time to Al-Kufa and Abu Ja’far Al-Mansour was with it. When we arrived at Al-Hashimiyya, a city of Abu Ja’far, heasws extracted hisasws leg from the stirrups, then descended and called for a young mule, and wore white clothes and a white headgear. So when heasws went over to him, Abu Ja’far said to himasws, ‘Youasws have resembled yourselfasws with the Prophetsas’. So Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘And it means you are distancing measws from the sonsasws of the Prophetsas’.  So he said, ‘I was thinking that I would send to Al-Medina, the ones who would uproot its palm trees and make captives of its offspring’. So heasws said: ‘And why is that, O commander of the faithful?’ So he said, ‘It has been raised to me that yourasws slave Al-Moala Bin Khunays is calling (people) to youasws and is gathering the wealth for youasws’. So heasws said: ‘By Allahazwj that is not so’. So he said, ‘I would not agree with youasws except with (matters of) the divorce, and the emancipation, and the sacrifice, and the walking (to the Kabah)’. So heasws said: ‘Is it with the rivals from besides Allahazwj that you are instructing me that Iasws should be swearing? The one who is not pleased with Allahazwj, so he has nothing to do with Allahazwj, regarding anything’.  So he said, ‘Are you using jurisprudence (Fiqh) upon me?’ So heasws said: ‘Iasws distance myselfasws from the jurisprudence (Fiqh), and Iasws am a sonasws of Rasool-Allahsaww’. So he said, ‘So I shall gather between youasws and the one who informed with you’. So he did it. So the man who had informed of it, came over. So Abu Abdullahasws said to him: ‘O you! So he said, ‘Yes, by Allahazwj besides Whom there is no god except for Himazwj, the Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Beneficent, the Merciful, I did do it’.  So Abu Abdullahasws said to him: ‘Woe be unto you! You Glorify Allahazwj thinking Heazwj would be too Embarrassed from Punishing you? But say, ‘I disavow from the Might and Strength of Allahazwj and I come to my own might and strength’. So the man swore by it, and he had not completed it and he fell down dead’. So Abu Ja’far said to himasws, ‘I will not ratify against you after it, ever, and I would make good yourasws allowing and yourasws refuting’.

t: Chapter 4 – The white clothes and the cotton
ar: قال امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) البسوا ثياب القطن فانها لباس رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) و هو لباسنا .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Wear the cotton clothes, for these are the clothes of Rasool-Allahsaww, and these are ourasws clothes’.

t: Chapter 40 – Burying the hair and the nails
ar: الله عز و جل ا لم نجعل الارض كفاتا احياء و امواتا قال دفن الشعر و الظفر .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of his companions, from Abu Kahmas,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [77:25] Have We not made the earth as a place [77:26] For the living and the dead. Heasws said: Burying of the hair and the nails’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: كان رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) يكتحل بالاثمد اذا اوي الي فراشه وترا وترا .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Suleym Al Farra’a, from a man,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww used to apply kohl with antimony (white powder) whenever hesaww went to hissaww bed, once, once (in each eye)’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: اراني ابو الحسن ( عليه السلام ) ميلا من حديد و مكحله من عظام فقال هذا كان لابي الحسن فاكتحل به فاكتحلت .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Hassan Bin Al Jaham who said,  ‘Abu Al-Hassanasws showed me an iron needle (applicator) and Kohl container (made out of) bone, so heasws said: ‘It used to be for Abu Al-Hassanasws to apply it, so Iasws apply it’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: الكحل بالليل ينفع العين و هو بالنهار زينه .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Safwan, from Zurara,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The (application of) the Kohl at night benefits the eyes, and it is an adornment by the day’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: ا قال ابو جعفر ( عليه السلام ) الاكتحال بالاثمد يطيب النكهه و يشد اشفار العين .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Fal Al Hashimy, from his father and his uncle who both said,  ‘Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘Application of Kohl with antimony (white eye-powder) aromatises the breath and strengthens the edges of the eyes’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: الكحل يعذب الفم .
en: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Hammad Bin Isa,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The Kohl freshens the mouth’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: الكحل ينبت الشعر و يحد البصر و يعين علي طول السجود .
en: From him, from his father, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from the one who mentioned,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The Kohl grows the hair and sharpens the vision and assists upon the prolonged Prostrations’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: الاثمد يجلو البصر و ينبت الشعر و يذهب بالدمعه .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba,  (It has been narrated) from a man from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The antimony clears the vision, and grows the hair, and removes the tears’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: الكحل يزيد في المباضعه .
en: Ibn Fazzal, from one of our companions,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said:’ The Kohl increased in the copulation’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: من نام علي اثمد غير ممسك امن من الماء الاسود ابدا ما دام ينام عليه .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, form Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ahmad Bin Al Mubarak, from Al Husayn Bin Al Hassan Bin Aasim, from his father,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who sleeps upon antimony (white eye powder) without putting musk in it would be safe from the black water (blackness in the eyes) for ever for as long as he sleeps upon it’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: الكحل ينبت الشعر و يجفف الدمعه و و يعذب الريق و يجلو البصر .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Hammad Bin Usman,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The application of Kohl grows the hair, and removes the tears, and freshens the saliva, and clears the vision’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: قال امير المومنين ( صلوات الله عليه ) من اكتحل فليوتر و من فعل فقد احسن و من لم يفعل فلا باس .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Al Qaddah,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The one who applies Kohl so let him do it once, and the one who does it so he has done good, and the one who does not do it, so there is no problem’.

t: Chapter 41 – The Kohl (Eyeliner)
ar: ان رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) كان يكتحل قبل ان ينام اربعا في اليمني و ثلاثا في اليسري .
en: From him, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Safwan, from Zurara,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww used to apply Kohl before hesaww slept – four (times) in the right, and three (times) in the left’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) من اخلاق الانبياء ( عليهم السلام ) السواك .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘From the mannerisms of the Prophetsas is the brushing of teeth’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: السواك من سنن المرسلين .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, and Al Husayn Bin Saeed altogether from Al Qasim Bin Urwat, from Is’haq Bin Ammar,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Brushing of the teeth is from the Sunnah of the Mursil Prophetsas’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) ما زال جبرييل ( عليه السلام ) يوصيني بالسواك حتي خشيت ان ادرد و احفي .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Jibraeelas did not cease to advise mesaww with brushing of the teeth to the extent that Isaww feared being toothless and with thin teeth’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: قال امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) السواك مطهره للفم و مرضاه للرب .
en: And by this chain –  ‘Heasws said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The brushing of the teeth is a cleansing for the mouth and a Pleasure of the Lordazwj’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: سمعت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) يقول في السواك عشره خصال مطهره للفم و مرضاه للرب و مفرحه للملايكه و هو من السنه و يشد اللثه و يجلو البصر و يذهب بالبلغم و يذهب بالحفر .
en: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Bahr, from Mihzam Al Asady who said,  ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘In brushing of the teeth are ten qualities – Cleansing for the mouth, and a Pleasure of the Lordazwj, and a happiness for the Angels, and it is from the Sunnah, and it strengthens the gums, and polishes the vision, and it removes the phlegm, and removes the cavities’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: في السواك اثنتا عشر خصله هو من السنه و مطهره للفم و مجلاه للبصر و يرضي الرب و يذهب بالبلغم و يزيد في الحفظ و يبيض الاسنان و يضاعف الحسنات و يذهب بالحفر و يشد اللثه و يشهي الطعام و تفرح به الملايكه .
en: From him, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ubeydullah Al Dahqan, from Dorost, from Ibn Sinan,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘In brushing of the teeth are twelve qualities – It is from the Sunnah, and a cleansing for the mouth, and a polishing for the vision, and a Pleasure of the Lordazwj, and it removes the phlegm, and increases in the memorisation, and it whitens the teeth, and it amplifies the Rewards, and removes the cavities, and strengthens the gums, and it makes one desirous of the food, and the Angels are happy with it’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: السواك يذهب بالدمعه و يجلو البصر .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Hammad Bin Isa,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The brushing of teeth removes the tears and polishes the vision’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) اوصاني جبرييل ( عليه السلام ) بالسواك حتي خفت علي اسناني .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Jibraeelas advised me with brushing of the teeth to the extent that Isaww feared upon mysaww teeth’.

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) ما لي اراكم قلحا ما لكم لا تستاكون .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Marzaban Bin Al Noman, raising it, said,  ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘What is the matter Isaww see you all with yellow teeth? What is the matter with you that you are not brushing your teeth?’

t: Chapter 42 – Brushing the teeth
ar: وصيه النبي ( صلي الله عليه واله ) لامير المومنين ( صلوات الله عليه ) عليك بالسواك لكل صلاه .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Amro Bin Abu Al Miqdam, from Muhammad Bin Marwan,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding a bequest of the Prophetsaww to Amir Al-Momineenasws: ‘Upon youasws is with brushing of the teeth during every Prayer’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) قال امير المومنين ( صلوات الله عليه ) نعم البيت الحمام يذكر النار و يذهب بالدرن و قال عمر بيس البيت الحمام يبدي العوره و يهتك الستر قال و نسب الناس قول امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) الي عمر و قول عمر الي امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, or someone else from Muhammad Bin Aslam Al Jably, raising it, said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The best of the houses is the bathhouse. It reminds of the Fire and removes the filth’; and Umar said, ‘The worst of the houses is the bathhouse, it exposes the genitals and the tears down the veil’. Heasws said: ‘And the people ascribed the words of Amir Al-Momineenasws to Umar and the words of Umar to Amir Al-Momineenasws’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: الحمام يوم و يوم لا يكثر اللحم و ادمانه في كل يوم يذيب شحم الكليتين .
en: From him, from Ali Bin Al Hakam and Ali Bin Hassan, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassanasws having said: ‘Bathing a day, and not a day (alternatively) does not increase the flesh, and being habitual of it during every day removes the fat of the kidneys’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) من كان يومن بالله و اليوم الاخر فلا يدخل الحمام الا بميزر .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Rafa’at Bin Musa,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one who was a believer in Allahazwj and the Last Day, so he should not enter the bathhouse except with a loincloth’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: مرضت حتي ذهب لحمي فدخلت علي الرضا ( صلوات الله عليه ) فقال ا يسرك ان يعود اليك لحمك قلت بلي قال الزم الحمام غبا فانه يعود اليك لحمك و اياك ان تدمنه فان ادمانه يورث السل .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Hajjal, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary who said,  ‘I was sick to the extent that my flesh went away. So I went over to Al-Rezaasws, so heasws said: ‘Would you be joyful if Iasws were to return your flesh to you?’ I said, ‘Yes’. Heasws said: ‘Necessitate the bathing intermittently so it would return back to you your flesh, and beware of being habitual of it, for being habitual in it inherits the tuberculosis’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: لا تدخل الحمام الا و في جوفك شي‏ء يطفا به عنك وهج المعده و هو اقوي للبدن و لا تدخله و انت ممتلي من الطعام .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Musna Bin Al Waleed Al Hannat, from Abu Baseer,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Do not enter the bathhouse except in your inside is something to cool down the heat of your stomach with, and it is more strengthening for your body, and do not enter it and you are filled up from the food’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: ه كان اذا اراد دخول الحمام تناول شييا فاكله قال قلت له ان الناس عندنا يقولون انه علي الريق اجود ما يكون قال لا بل يوكل شي‏ء قبله يطفي المراره و يسكن حراره الجوف .
en: Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Rafa’at Bin Musa, from the one who informed it,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws that whenever heasws wanted to enter the bathhouse, heasws took something, so heasws ate it. I said to himasws, ‘The people with us are saying that it is much better upon the empty stomach as can be’. Heasws said: ‘No, but eating something before it cools the gallbladder and settles the heat of the interior’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: دخلت انا و ابي و جدي و عمي حماما بالمدينه فاذا رجل في بيت المسلخ فقال لنا ممن القوم فقلنا من اهل العراق فقال و اي العراق قلنا كوفيون فقال مرحبا بكم يا اهل الكوفه انتم الشعار دون الدثار ثم قال ما يمنعكم من الازر فان رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) قال عوره المومن علي المومن حرام قال فبعث الي ابي كرباسه فشقها باربعه ثم اخذ كل واحد منا واحدا ثم دخلنا فيها فلما كنا في البيت الحار صمد لجدي فقال يا كهل ما يمنعك من الخضاب فقال له جدي ادركت من هو خير مني و منك لا يختضب قال فغضب لذلك حتي عرفنا غضبه في الحمام قال و من ذلك الذي هو خير مني فقال ادركت علي بن ابي طالب ( عليه السلام ) و هو لا يختضب قال فنكس راسه و تصاب عرقا فقال صدقت و بررت ثم قال يا كهل ان تختضب فان رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) قد خضب و هو خير من علي ( عليه السلام ) و ان تترك فلك بعلي سنه قال فلما خرجنا من الحمام سالنا عن الرجل فاذا هو علي بن الحسين ( عليه السلام ) و معه ابنه محمد بن علي ( عليه السلام ) .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, altogether from Hanan Bin sadeyr, from his father who said,  ‘I and my father, and my grandfather, and my uncle went over to a bathhouse at Al-Medina, so there was a manasws in the dressing room. So he said to us, ‘From whom are the people?’ So we said, ‘From the people of Al-Iraq’. So heasws said, ‘And from where in Al-Iraq?’ We said, ‘Kufians (from Kufa)’. So heasws said, ‘Welcome to you all, of people of Al-Kufa. You all are wearing clothes and are without a towel’. Then heasws said, ‘What is preventing you from the loincloth, for Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The nakedness of the Believer upon the Believer is Prohibited’.  He (the narrator) said, ‘Heasws sent a cloth to my father, so he tore it into four pieces, and each one of us took one from it. Then we entered into it. So when we were in the hot house, heasws turned towards my grandfather, so heasws said, ‘O elderly, what prevents you from the dyeing?’ So my grandfather said to him, ‘I was with someone who was better than me and youasws, who did not dye’. So heasws got so angered due to that to the extent that we recognised hisasws anger in the bathhouse. Heasws said, ‘And who is that who is better than measws?’ So he said, ‘I was with Aliasws Bin Abu Talibasws and heasws did not dye’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So heasws bowed his head and perspired, so heasws said, ‘You speak the truth, and are justified’. Then he said, ‘O elderly, you should dye, for Rasool-Allahsaww had dyed, and hesaww was better than Aliasws, and if you leave it, so for you is a Sunnah with Aliasws’. So when we went out from the bathhouse, we asked about the man, so it was Aliasws Bin Al-Husaynasws and with himasws was hisasws sonasws Muhammadasws Bin Aliasws’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: دخلت مع ابي بصير الحمام فنظرت الي ابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) قد اطلي و اطلي ابطيه بالنوره قال فخبرت ابا بصير فقال ارشدني اليه لاساله عنه فقلت قد رايته انا فقال انت قد رايته و انا لم اره ارشدني اليه قال فارشدته اليه فقال له جعلت فداك اخبرني قايدي انك قد اطليت و طليت ابطيك بالنوره قال نعم يا ابا محمد ان نتف الابطين يضعف البصر اطل يا ابا محمد قال فقال اطليت منذ ايام فقال اطل فانه طهور .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,  ‘I entered the bathhouse along with Abu Baseer, so we looked at Abu Abdullahasws had waxed, and heasws had waxed hisasws underarms with Al-Noura. So I informed Abu Baseer, so he said, ‘Guide me to himasws to ask himasws about it’. So I said, ‘I have seen himasws’. So he said, ‘You have seen himasws, and I cannot see himasws’, (as he was blind). Guide me to himasws’. So I guided him to himasws, so he said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! My guide informed me that youasws have waxed, and waxed yourasws underarms with Al-Noura’. Heasws said: ‘Yes, O Abu Muhammad! Plucking the underarms weakens the vision. Wax, O Abu Muhammad’. So he said, ‘I have waxed a few days beforehand’. So heasws said: ‘Wax, for it is cleaner’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: دخلت علي جماعه من بني هاشم فسلمت عليهم في بيت مظلم فقال بعضهم سلم علي ابي الحسن ( عليه السلام ) فانه في الصدر قال فسلمت عليه و جلست بين يديه فقلت له قد احببت ان القاك منذ حين لاسالك عن اشياء فقال سل ما بدا لك قلت ما تقول في الحمام قال لا تدخل الحمام الا بميزر و غض بصرك و لا تغتسل من غساله ماء الحمام فانه يغتسل فيه من الزنا و يغتسل فيه ولد الزنا و الناصب لنا اهل البيت و هو شرهم .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam,  (It has been narrated) from a man from the Clan of Hashimas who said, ‘I went over to a group from the Clan of Hashimas, so I greeted them in a dark room. So one of them said, ‘Greet Abu Al Hassanasws, for heasws is in the centre’. So I greeted himasws and sat in front of himasws, and I said to himasws, ‘I desired to meet youasws for a while to ask youasws about certain things’. So heasws said: ‘Ask, whatever comes to you’. I said, ‘What are youasws saying regarding the bathhouse’. Heasws said: ‘Do not enter the bathhouse except with a loincloth, and lowering your eyes, and do not wash from the used water of the bathhouse for there has washed in it the adulterer, and the son of the adulterer, and the Hostile one (Nasibi) towards usasws, the Peopleasws of the Household, and he is the most evil of them’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: من اراد ان يحمل لحما فليدخل الحمام يوما و يغب يوما و من اراد ان يضمر و كان كثير اللحم فليدخل الحمام كل يوم .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Ahmad Bin Asheym, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary,  (Heasws) having said: ‘The one who wants to carry flesh (to gain weight) so let him enter the bathhouse one day, and be absent from it one day, and the one who intends slimming and he was of a lot of flesh, so let him enter the bathhouse every day’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: سالت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) عن الرجل يطلي بالنوره فيجعل له الدقيق بالزيت يلت به فيمسح به بعد النوره ليقطع ريحها عنه قال لا باس .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said,  ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the man who waxes with Al-Noura, so he makes a container for himself of the flour with the oil to paste with it, so he touches with it upon himself after Al-Noura in order to cut-off its smell from himself’. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: حديث اخر لعبد الرحمن قال رايت ابا الحسن ( عليه السلام ) و قد تدلك بدقيق ملتوت بالزيت فقلت له ان الناس يكرهون ذلك قال لا باس به .
en: And in another Hadeeth of Abdul Rahman, he said,  ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassanasws and he had massaged with flour mixed with oil. So I said to himasws, ‘The people are disliking that’. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with it’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: سيل ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) عن التدلك بالدقيق بعد النوره فقال لا باس قلت يزعمون انه اسراف فقال ليس فيما اصلح البدن اسراف اني ربما امرت بالنقي فيلت لي بالزيت فاتدلك به انما الاسراف فيما اتلف المال و اضر بالبدن .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Is’haq Bin Abdul Aziz who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws was asked about the massaging with the flour (mixed with oil) after Al-Noura, so heasws said: ‘There is no problem’. I said, ‘They (people) are alleging that it is an extravagance’. So heasws said: ‘There is no extravagance in the correction (well-being) of the body. Sometimes I order with the pure (flour), so it is mixed for measws with the oil, so I massage with it. But rather, the extravagance is in what is destruction of the wealth and harmful for the body’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: الرجل يطلي و يتدلك بالزيت و الدقيق قال لا باس به .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Abu Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassanasws regarding the man who waxes and massages with the oil and the flour. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with it’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قلت لابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) انا لنسافر و لا يكون معنا نخاله فنتدلك بالدقيق فقال لا باس انما الفساد فيما اضر بالبدن و اتلف المال فاما ما اصلح البدن فانه ليس بفساد اني ربما امرت غلامي فلت لي النقي بالزيت فاتدلك به .
en: Ali Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Aslam Al Jabaly, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Aban Bin Taglub who said,  ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘We tend to travel and there does not happen to be any bran with us, so we massage with the flour’. So heasws said: ‘There is no problem. But rather, the spoiling is in what is harmful for the body, and the destruction of the wealth. So as for what is corrective for the body, so it is no with spoiling. Sometimes Iasws order myasws slave, ‘Prepare for measws the pure flour with the oil, so Iasws massage with it’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: خرج ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) من الحمام فتلبس و تعمم فقال لي اذا خرجت من الحمام فتعمم قال فما تركت العمامه عند خروجي من الحمام في شتاء و لا صيف .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws went out from the bathhouse, so heasws had worn clothes and a turban. Heasws said to me: ‘Whenever you come out from the bathhouse, so wear a turban’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So I did not neglect the turban during my coming out from the bathhouse, during the winter and the summer’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: سالته عن الرجل يطلي فيبول و هو قايم قال لا باس به .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from a man,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the man who waxes, and he urinates while he is standing’. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with it’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: كان امير المومنين ( صلوات الله عليه ) يقول الا لا يستلقين احدكم في الحمام فانه يذيب شحم الكليتين و لا يدلكن رجليه بالخزف فانه يورث الجذام .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Umar Bin Yazeed,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws was saying: ‘Indeed! Not one of you should lie down in the bathhouse, for it melts the fat of the kidneys, and he should not massage his leg with the clay for it inherits the leprosy’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: كنا جماعه من اصحابنا دخلنا الحمام فلما خرجنا لقينا ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) فقال لنا من اين اقبلتم فقلنا له من الحمام فقال انقي الله غسلكم فقلنا له جعلنا فداك و انا جينا معه حتي دخل الحمام فجلسنا له حتي خرج فقلنا له انقي الله غسلك فقال طهركم الله .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, from Abdullah Bin Muskan who said,  ‘We were a group of our companions, and we entered the bathhouse. So when we went out, we met Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws said to us: ‘Where are you coming back from?’ So we said to himasws, ‘From the bathhouse’. So heasws said: ‘May Allahazwj Purify your bathing’. So we said to himasws, ‘May we be sacrificed for youasws’. And we went with himasws until heasws entered the bathhouse. So we sat around (waiting) for himasws until heasws came out. So we said to himasws, ‘May Allahazwj Purify yourasws bathing’. So heasws said: ‘May Allahazwj Clean you all’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: ان الحسن بن علي ( عليه السلام ) خرج من الحمام فلقيه انسان فقال طاب استحمامك فقال يا لكع و ما تصنع بالاست هاهنا فقال طاب حميمك فقال ا ما تعلم ان الحميم العرق قال فطاب حمامك قال و اذا طاب حمامي فاي شي‏ء لي و لكن قل طهر ما طاب منك و طاب ما طهر منك .
en: Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, and Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ibrahim Bin Is’haq Al Nahawandy, from Abdul Rahman Bin Hammad, from Abu Maryam Al Ansary, raising it, said,  ‘Al-Hassanasws Bin Aliasws went out from the bathhouse, a person came across himasws, so he said, ‘May yourasws Istihmamuk be good’. So heasws said: ‘O dimwit, and are you doing with utilising the ‘ist’ over here (in the word)?’ So he said, ‘May your Hameemuk be good’. So heasws said: ‘But do you not know that Al-Hameem is the perspiration?’ He said, ‘May your Hamaamuk be good’. Heasws said: ‘And when myasws bathing is good, so which thing is for measws, but say, ‘May it be purified what is good from youasws, and may it be good what is purified from youasws’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: سالت ابا جعفر ( عليه السلام ) عن الحمام فقال تريد الحمام فقلت نعم قال فامر باسخان الحمام ثم دخل فاتزر بازار و غطي ركبتيه و سرته ثم امر صاحب الحمام فطلي ما كان خارجا من الازار ثم قال اخرج عني ثم طلي هو ما تحته بيده ثم قال هكذا فافعل .
en: A number of our companons, from sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ismail Bin Yasaar, from Usman Bin Affan Al Sadousy, from Basheer Al Nabaal who said,  ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws the bathhouse, so heasws said: ‘Do you want to bathing?’ So I said, ‘Yes’.  He (the narrator) said, ‘So heasws ordered with the warming of the bath, then heasws entered it, and heasws was wearing a trouser, and hisasws knees were covered, as well as hisasws navel. Then heasws ordered the one in charge of the bathhouse, so heasws anointed what was outside from the trouser. Then heasws said: ‘go away from measws’. Then heasws anointed what was underneath it by hisasws own hands, then said: ‘This is how, so do it’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) لا يدخل الرجل مع ابنه الحمام فينظر الي عورته .
en: Sahl, raising it, said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The man should not enter the bathhouse along with his son, so that he would look at his nakedness’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) لا تتك في الحمام فانه يذيب شحم الكليتين و لا تسرح في الحمام فانه يرقق الشعر و لا تغسل راسك بالطين فانه يذهب بالغيره و لا تتدلك بالخزف فانه يورث البرص و لا تمسح وجهك بالازار فانه يذهب بماء الوجه .
en: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ibrahim Bin Is’haq, from Yusuf Bin Al Sukht, raising it, said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Do not lean (reclining posture) in the bathhouse, for it melts the fat of the kidneys; and do not comb in the bathhouse, for it thins the hair; and do not wash your head with the clay, for it removed the self-esteem; and do not massage with the clay for it inherits the vitiligo; and do not wipe your face with the trouser for it removes the water of the face’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) لا تغسلوا رءوسكم بطين مصر فانه يذهب بالغيره و يورث الدياثه .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Asbaat,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Do not wash your heads with Egyptian clay, for it removes the self-esteem and in inherits the despicability’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: العوره عورتان القبل و الدبر فاما الدبر مستور بالاليتين فاذا سترت القضيب و البيضتين فقد سترت العوره و قال في روايه اخري و اما الدبر فقد سترته الاليتان و اما القبل فاستره بيدك .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Yahya Al Wasity, from one of our companions,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazyasws (7th Imamasws) having said: ‘The private parts are of two types, the front and the back. So as for the back, it is veiled by the two buttocks. So when the manhood and the two organs (under it) are veiled, so the private parts have been veiled’.  And heasws said in another report: ‘And as for the back, so the two buttocks have veiled it, and as for the front, so veil it with your hands’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: النظر الي عوره من ليس بمسلم مثل نظرك الي عوره الحمار .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from someone else,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The looking at a private part of the one who is not a Muslim is like looking at the private parts of the donkey’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: سالت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) ا يتجرد الرجل عند صب الماء تري عورته او يصب عليه الماء او يري هو عوره الناس فقال كان ابي يكره ذلك من كل احد .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Ibn Abu Yafour who said,  ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Can the man be bare during the pouring of the water to see his own private parts, or the water is poured over him, or he see the private parts of the people?’ So heasws said: ‘Myasws fatherasws disliked that from every one’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: من كان يومن بالله و اليوم الاخر فلا يدخل حليلته الحمام .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Rafa’at,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who was a believer in Allahazwj and the Last Day, so he should not let his wife go to the bathhouse’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: من كان يومن بالله و اليوم الاخر فلا يرسل حليلته الي الحمام .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who was a believer in Allahazwj and the Last Day, so he should not send his wife to the bathhouse’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قلت لابي الحسن ( عليه السلام ) اقرا القران في الحمام و انكح قال لا باس .
en: From him, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,  ‘I said to Abu Al-Hassanasws, ‘Reciting the Quran in the bathhouse and the copulation?’ Heasws said: ‘There is no problem’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: سالت ابا جعفر ( عليه السلام ) ا كان امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) ينهي عن قراءه القران في الحمام قال لا انما نهي ان يقرا الرجل و هو عريان فاما اذا كان عليه ازار فلا باس .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,  ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws, ‘Was Amir Al-Momineenasws forbidding from reciting the Quran in the bathhouse?’ Heasws said: ‘No, but rather heasws had forbidden that the man should be reciting whilst he is naked. So when there was a trouser upon him, so there is no problem’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: لا باس للرجل ان يقرا القران في الحمام اذا كان يريد به وجه الله و لا يريد ينظر كيف صوته .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahimm, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘There is no problem for the man that he should recite the Quran in the bathhouse, when he intends the Face of Allahazwj by it, and he does not want to look at how (good) his voice was’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: قال لا تضطجع في الحمام فانه يذيب شحم الكليتين .
en: One of our companions, from Ibn Jamhour, from Muhammad Bin Al Qasim, from Ibn Abu Yafour,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Do not lie down in the bathhouse, for it melts the fat of the kidneys’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: ابا جعفر ( عليه السلام ) كان يقول من كان يومن بالله و اليوم الاخر فلا يدخل الحمام الا بميزر الحسين بن محمد عن معلي بن محمد عن احمد بن محمد بن عبد الله عن محمد بن جعفر عن بعض رجاله عن ابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) قال قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) لا يدخل الرجل مع ابنه الحمام فينظر الي عورته و قال ليس للوالدين ان ينظرا الي عوره الولد و ليس للولد ان ينظر الي عوره الوالد و قال لعن رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) الناظر و المنظور اليه في الحمام بلا ميزر . و قال ليس للوالدين ان ينظرا الي عوره الولد و ليس للولد ان ينظر الي عوره الوالد و قال لعن رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) الناظر و المنظور اليه في الحمام بلا ميزر .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Umar Bin Ali Bin Umar Bin Yazeed, from his uncle Muhammad Bin Umar, from one who narrated it that,  ‘Abu Ja’farasws was saying: ‘The one who was a believer in Allahazwj and the Last Day, so he should not enter the bathhouse except with a loin cloth’.  Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ja’far, from one of his men,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The man should not enter the bathhouse along with his son, so he would look at his nakedness’.  And heasws said: ‘It is not for the parent that they should look at the private part of the children, and it is not the children that they should look at the nakedness of the parents’.  And heasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww cursed the onlooker and the one looked at in the bathhouse, without a trouser’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: دخل ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) الحمام فقال له صاحب الحمام اخليه لك فقال لا حاجه لي في ذلك المومن اخف من ذلك .
en: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, form sa’adan, from Abu Baseer who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws entered the bathhouse, so the one in charge of the bathhouse said to him, ‘I shall empty it for youasws’. So heasws said: ‘There is no need for measws with regards to that is hidden from that’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: حدثنا محمد بن علي بن جعفر عن ابي الحسن الرضا ( عليه السلام ) قال من اخذ من الحمام خزفه فحك بها جسده فاصابه البرص فلا يلومن الا نفسه و من اغتسل من الماء الذي قد اغتسل فيه فاصابه الجذام فلا يلومن الا نفسه قال محمد بن علي فقلت لابي الحسن ( عليه السلام ) ان اهل المدينه يقولون ان فيه شفاء من العين فقال كذبوا يغتسل فيه الجنب من الحرام و الزاني و الناصب الذي هو شرهما و كل خلق من خلق الله ثم يكون فيه شفاء من العين انما شفاء العين قراءه الحمد و المعوذتين و ايه الكرسي و البخور بالقسط و المر و اللبان .
en: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Sa’ad, from Muhammad Bin salim, from Musa Bin Abdullah Bin Musa,  ‘Muhammad Bin Ali, son of Ja’farasws narrated to us from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws having said: ‘The one who takes clay from the bathhouse and he rubs his body with it, so the vitiligo hits him, so he should not blame anyone except for himself; and the one who washed from the water which had been bathed in, and the leprosy hits him, so he should not blame anyone except for himself’.  Muhammad Bin Ali (the narrator) said, ‘So I said to Abu Al-Hassanasws that the people of Al-Medina are saying that there is a healing in it from the (evil) eyes’. So heasws said: ‘They are lying! There bathe in it the ones who have sexual impurities from the Prohibition (adultery), and the adulterer, and the Hostile one (Nasibi) who is the most evil of them, and every creature from the creatures of Allahazwj, then there would be a healing in it? But rather, a healing from the (evil) eye is recitation of Al-Hamd (Chapter 1), and Al-Mawazatayn (Chapter 113 & 114), and the Verse of the Chair [2:255], and the vapour of the incense with Al-Qust (saussurea), and Al-Murr (myrhh), and Al-Loban (frankincense)’.

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: دخل ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) الحمام فقال له صاحب الحمام اخليه لك فقال لا حاجه لي في ذلك المومن اخف من ذلك .
en: 37. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa‘dan from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once entered a bathhouse and the owner of the bathhouse asked him (the Imam), ‘Must I vacate it for you?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘That is not necessary. A believing person (his needs) is lighter than that.’”

t: Chapter 43 – The Bathhouse
ar: حدثنا محمد بن علي بن جعفر عن ابي الحسن الرضا ( عليه السلام ) قال من اخذ من الحمام خزفه فحك بها جسده فاصابه البرص فلا يلومن الا نفسه و من اغتسل من الماء الذي قد اغتسل فيه فاصابه الجذام فلا يلومن الا نفسهقال محمد بن علي فقلت لابي الحسن ( عليه السلام ) ان اهل المدينه يقولون ان فيه شفاء من العين فقال كذبوا يغتسل فيه الجنب من الحرام و الزاني و الناصب الذي هو شرهما و كل خلق من خلق الله ثم يكون فيه شفاء من العين انما شفاء العين قراءه الحمد و المعوذتين و ايه الكرسي و البخور بالقسط و المر و اللبان .
en: 38. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad from Sa‘d ibn Muhammad ibn Salim from Musa ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Musa who has said that narrated to us Ali ibn Ja‘far the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If one picks up a piece of pottery from a bathhouse and rubs himself with it, then becomes ill with leprosy he must not blame anyone except himself. One who washes with the used water of a bathhouse and becomes ill with leprosy, he also must not blame anyone else except himself.’ Muhammad ibn Ali has said, ‘I said to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that people of al-Madinah say, “There is cure (and protection) in it against the evil effect of the eyes.’” He (the Imam) said, ‘They have spoken a lie. In it people after unlawful sexual acts bathe and fornicators bathe. In it, the worst of all creatures that Allah has created, the enemies of Ahl al-Bayt, bathe and then they say that there is cure (and protection) in it against the evil effects of the eyes. Cure for the eyes because of such effect is in reading al-Hamd (Chapter one) and al-Ma‘udhatayn (chapters One Hundred Thirteen and One Hundred Fourteen), Ayatu al-Kursi [2:255] and burning incense of al-Qust, (a certain Indian or Arabian wood), al-Murr (gum of a certain tree) and al-Luban (frankincense).”’

t: Chapter 44 – Washing the head
ar: تقليم الاظفار و الاخذ من الشارب و غسل الراس بالخطمي ينفي الفقر و يزيد في الرزق .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, form Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sufyan Bin Al Samt,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Clipping the nails, and taking from the moustache, and washing the head with the hibiscus negates the poverty and increases in the livelihood’.

t: Chapter 44 – Washing the head
ar: غسل الراس بالخطمي في كل جمعه امان من البرص و الجنون .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Washing the head with the hibiscus during every Friday is a safety from the vitiligo and the insanity’.

t: Chapter 44 – Washing the head
ar: قال امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) غسل الراس بالخطمي يذهب بالدرن و ينفي الاقذاء .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Washing the head with the hibiscus removes the dirt and the filth’.

t: Chapter 44 – Washing the head
ar: من اخذ من شاربه و قلم اظفاره و غسل راسه بالخطمي يوم الجمعه كان كمن اعتق نسمه .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, form Muhammad Bin Al Husayn Bin Musa Bin Sa’adan, from Abdullah Bin Sinan,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who takes from his moustache, and clips his nails, and washes his head with the hibiscus on the day of Friday would be like the one who emancipated a person’.

t: Chapter 44 – Washing the head
ar: غسل الراس بالخطمي نشره .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Al Sayrafi, from Ismail Bin Abdul Khaliq,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Washing the head with the hibiscus is an advertisement (of beauty)’.

t: Chapter 44 – Washing the head
ar: سمعت ابا الحسن ( عليه السلام ) يقول غسل الراس بالسدر يجلب الرزق جلبا .
en: From him, form Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Mansour Bin Buzraj who said,  ‘I heard Abu Al-Hassanasws saying: ‘Washing the head with the lotus bring the livelihood with a (strong) bringing’.

t: Chapter 44 – Washing the head
ar: لما امر الله عز و جل رسوله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) باظهار الاسلام و ظهر الوحي راي قله من المسلمين و كثره من المشركين فاهتم رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) هما شديدا فبعث الله عز و جل اليه جبرييل ( عليه السلام ) بسدر من سدره المنتهي فغسل به راسه فجلا به همه .
en: From him, form Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ubeyd Bin yahya Al Sowr Al Attar, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn Al Alawy, from his father, from his grandfather,  (It has been narrated) from Aliasws having said: ‘When Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Commanded Hisazwj Rasoolsaww with the manifestation of Al-Islam and the Revelation appeared, hesaww saw the scarcity of the Muslims and abundance of the Polytheists. So Rasool-Allahsaww was aggrieved by an intense grief. So Allahazwj Sent Jibraeelas to himsaww with a lotus from the Lotus Tree (Al-Sidrat Al-Muntaha). So hesaww washed hissaww head with it, and hissaww grief was removed by it’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: قال امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) النوره طهور .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, form Suleym Al Fara’a who said,  ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Al-Noura is a cleanser’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: دخلت مع ابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) الحمام فقال لي يا عبد الرحمن اطل فقلت انما اطليت منذ ايام فقال اطل فانها طهور .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Al Hajjal, from Hammad Bin Usman,  (It has been narrated) from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘I entered the bathhouse along with Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws said to me: ‘O Abdul Rahman! Get waxing done’. So I said, ‘But rather I waxed a few days ago’. So heasws said: ‘Get waxing done for it is a cleansing’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: دخل ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) الحمام و انا اريد ان اخرج منه فقال يا محمد ا لا تطلي فقلت عهدي به منذ ايام فقال ا ما علمت انها طهور .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from Abu Kahmas, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Ali Bin Al Husayn who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws entered the bathhouse and I wanted to exit from it. So heasws said: ‘O Muhammad! Did you not get waxing done?’ So I said, ‘I did apply with it a few days ago’. So heasws said: ‘But do you not know that it is a cleansing?’

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: بعث ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) ابن اخيه في حاجه فجاء و ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) قد اطلي بالنوره فقال له ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) اطل فقال انما عهدي بالنوره منذ ثلاث فقال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) ان النوره طهور .
en: A number of our companions, form Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from the one who reported it who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws send a son of hisasws brother regarding a need, so he came and Abu Abdullahasws waxed with Al-Noura. So Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Get waxing done’. So he said, ‘But rather, I had waxing done three (days) ago’. So Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Al-Noura is a cleanser’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: سمعت ابا الحسن ( عليه السلام ) يقول القوا عنكم الشعر فانه يحسن .
en: From him, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Naheyki, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed who said,  ‘I heard Abu Al-Hassanasws saying: ‘Cast off the hair from yourselves for it beautifies’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: كنت معه اقوده فادخلته الحمام فرايت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) يتنور فدنا منه ابو بصير فسلم عليه فقال يا ابا بصير تنور فقال انما تنورت اول من امس و اليوم الثالث فقال ا ما علمت انها طهور فتنور .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from one of his companions, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said,  ‘I (Abu Hamza) was with him (Abu Baseer) guiding him (as he was blind), so I entered the bathhouse, and I saw Abu Abdullahasws applying Noura. So Abu Baseer went near him and greeted himasws, so heasws said: ‘O Abu Baseer! Apply Noura’. So he said, ‘But rather, I had applied Noura first thing yesterday, and the third day’. So heasws said: ‘But do you not know that is it a cleanser? Therefore you should apply Noura’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: قال امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) النوره نشره و طهور للجسد .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Al-Noura is an advertisement (of beauty) and a cleanser for the body’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: قال امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) احب للمومن ان يطلي في كل خمسه عشر يوما .
en: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Iasws would love it for the Believer if he were to wax (to remove unwanted hair) during every fifteen days’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: السنه في النوره في كل خمسه عشر يوما فان اتت عليك عشرون يوما و ليس عندك فاستقرض علي الله .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ahmad Bin Al Mubarak, from Al Husayn Bin Ahmad Bin Al Minqary,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The Sunnah regarding Al-Noura is every fifteen days, so if twenty days were to come to you and it is not in your possession, so borrow upon Allahazwj’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: قيل له يزعم بعض الناس ان النوره يوم الجمعه مكروهه فقال ليس حيث ذهبت اي طهور اطهر من النوره يوم الجمعه .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah,  (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘It was said to himasws, ‘Some of the people are alleging that Al-Noura is disliked on the day of Friday’. So heasws said: ‘It is not where you are going. Which cleanser is more purifying than Al-Noura on the day of Friday?’

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) من كان يومن بالله و اليوم الاخر فلا يترك عانته فوق اربعين يوما و لا يحل لامراه تومن بالله و اليوم الاخر ان تدع ذلك منها فوق عشرين يوما .
en: Ali Bin Ibrhim, form his father, from Al Nowfaly,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one who was a believer in Allahazwj and the Last Day, so he should not leave his pubic hair for more than forty days, nor is it Permissible for a woman who believes in Allahazwj and the Last Day that she should leave that from her for more than twenty days’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) طليه في الصيف خير من عشر في الشتاء .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hasan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Ahmad Bin Sa’aba, from Ammar Al Sabaty who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Waxing in the summer is better than ten in the winter’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) من اراد الاطلاء بالنوره فاخذ من النوره باصبعه فشمه و جعل علي طرف انفه و قال صلي الله علي سليمان بن داود كما امرنا بالنوره لم تحرقه النوره .
en: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, form Al Sayyari, raising it, said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The one who wants the waxing with Al-Nouran, so he should take from Al-Noura with his fingers, and paste it upon the sides of his nose and say, ‘May Allahazwj Send Blessings upon Suleymanas Bin Dawoodas just as heas ordered us with Al-Noura’, would not be burnt by Al-Noura’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: سمعت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) يقول كان رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) يطلي العانه و ما تحت الاليتين في كل جمعه .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin sinan, from Huzyefa Bin Mansour who said,  ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww used to wax the unwanted hairs, and what is beneath the kidneys, during every Friday’.

t: Chapter 45 – Al Noura (The lime paste)
ar: ه سمع علي بن الحسين ( عليه السلام ) يقول من قال اذا اطلي بالنوره اللهم طيب ما طهر مني و طهر ما طاب مني و ابدلني شعرا طاهرا لا يعصيك اللهم اني تطهرت ابتغاء سنه المرسلين و ابتغاء رضوانك و مغفرتك فحرم شعري و بشري علي النار و طهر خلقي و طيب خلقي و زك عملي و اجعلني ممن يلقاك علي الحنيفيه السمحه مله ابراهيم خليلك و دين محمد ( صلي الله عليه واله ) حبيبك و رسولك عاملا بشرايعك تابعا لسنه نبيك ( صلي الله عليه واله ) اخذا به متادبا بحسن تاديبك و تاديب رسولك و تاديب اوليايك الذين غذوتهم بادبك و زرعت الحكمه في صدورهم و جعلتهم معادن لعلمك صلواتك عليهم من قال ذلك طهره الله من الادناس في الدنيا و من الذنوب و ابدله شعرا لا يعصي الله و خلق الله بكل شعره من جسده ملكا يسبح له الي ان تقوم الساعه و ان تسبيحه من تسبيحهم تعدل بالف تسبيحه من تسبيح اهل الارض .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Zureyq Bin Al Zubeyr,  (It has been narrated) from Sadeyr who heard Aliasws Bin Al-Husaynasws saying: ‘The one who says, whenever he waxes with Al-Noura, ‘O Allahazwj! Make good what is clean from me, and Purify what is good from me, and replace for me with clean hair which would not disobey Youazwj.  O Allahazwj! I have cleaned seeking a Sunnah of the Mursil Prophetsas, and seeking Youazwj Pleasure, and Yourazwj Forgiveness, therefore Prohibit my hair and my person upon the Fire, and Purify my creation (body) and Make good my manners, and Purify my deeds, and Make me to be from the ones who would be meeting Youazwj upon the upright, the tolerant Religion of Ibrahimas, Yourazwj Friend, and the Religion of Muhammadsaww, Yourazwj Beloved, and Yourazwj Rasoolsaww, having abided by Yourazwj Laws, a follower of the Sunnah of Yourazwj Prophetsaww, having taken by it an education with the best of Yourazwj Education, and education of Yourazwj Rasoolsaww, and the education of Yourazwj Guardiansasws whom Youazwj Sustained with Yourazwj Education, and Cultivated the Wisdom in theirasws chests, and Made them the educators of Yourazwj Knowledge, may Blessing be upon themasws’.  The one who says that, Allahazwj would Purify him from the filth in the world, and from the sins, and Replace for him with hair which would not disobey Allahazwj, and Allahazwj would Created for every hair from his body, an Angel who would Glorify for him up to the Establishment of the Hour, and that a Glorification from its Glorifications equates with one thousand Glorifications from the Glorifications of the people of the earth’.

t: Chapter 46 – The Armpit
ar: قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) لا يطولن احدكم شعر ابطه فان الشيطان يتخذه مخبا ليستتر به .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Not one of you should prolong the hair of his armpits for the Satanla would take it as a hide-out to hide with by it’.

t: Chapter 46 – The Armpit
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) نتف الابط يضعف المنكبين و كان ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) يطلي ابطه .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from Abu Kahmasy who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Plucking the armpits weakens the shoulders’, and Abu Abdullahasws used to wax hisasws armpits’.

t: Chapter 46 – The Armpit
ar: ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) كان يطلي ابطه بالنوره في الحمام .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary that,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws used to wax hisasws armpits with Al-Noura in the bathhouse’.

t: Chapter 46 – The Armpit
ar: كنت مع ابي بصير في الحمام فرايت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) يطلي ابطه فاخبرت بذلك ابا بصير فقال له جعلت فداك ايما افضل نتف الابط او حلقه فقال يا ابا محمد ان نتف الابط يوهي او يضعف احلقه .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Sa’dan who said,  ‘I was with Abu Baseer in the bathhouse, so I saw Abu Abdullahasws waxing hisasws armpits, so I informed Abu Baseer of that, so he said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! Which is preferable, plucking the armpit or shaving it?’ So heaswssaid: ‘O Abu Muhammad! Plucking the armpit frails or weakens (the shoulders). Shave it’.

t: Chapter 46 – The Armpit
ar: كنا بالمدينه فلاحاني زراره في نتف الابط و حلقه فقلت حلقه افضل و قال زراره نتفه افضل فاستاذنا علي ابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) فاذن لنا و هو في الحمام يطلي قد اطلي ابطيه فقلت لزراره يكفيك قال لا لعله فعل هذا لما لا يجوز لي ان افعله فقال فيم انتم فقلت لاحاني زراره في نتف الابط و حلقه فقلت حلقه افضل و قال نتفه افضل فقال اصبت السنه و اخطاها زراره حلقه افضل من نتفه و طليه افضل من حلقه ثم قال لنا اطليا فقلنا فعلنا ذلك منذ ثلاث فقال اعيدا فان الاطلاء طهور.
en: One of our companions, from Ibn Jamhour, from Muhammad Bin Al Qasim, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from yusuf Bin Al Sukht Al Basry, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Ibrahim Bin Yahya Bin Abu Al Balaad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Mihran, altogether from Abdullah Bin Abu Yafour who said,  ‘We were at Al-Medina, so Zurara disputed with me regarding plucking the armpit and shaving it. So I said, ‘Shaving it is preferable’, and Zurara said, ‘Plucking it is preferable’. So we both sought permission to (see) Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws permitted for us and heasws was in the bathhouse waxing, having waxed hisasws armpits. So I said to Zurara, ‘Do it suffice for you?’ He said, ‘No, perhaps heasws has done this and it is not allowed for me that I do it’.  So heasws said: ‘In what (discussion) are you?’ So I said, ‘Zurara disputed with me regarding plucking of the armpit and the shaving of it’. So I said that shaving is preferable, and he said plucking is preferable’. So heasws said: ‘You have hit the Sunnah and Zurara has erred. Shaving it is preferable than plucking it, and waxing it is preferable than shaving it’. Then heasws said to us both: ‘Get waxing done’. So we both said, ‘We did that three (days) ago’. So heasws said: ‘Repeat it, for waxing is a cleanser’.

t: Chapter 46 – The Armpit
ar: ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) كان يدخل الحمام فيطلي ابطه وحده اذا احتاج الي ذلك وحده .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub that,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws used to enter the bathhouse, so heasws would wax hisasws armpit alone when heasws was needy to that alone’.

t: Chapter 46 – The Armpit
ar: بلغني ان ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) ربما دخل الحمام متعمدا يطلي ابطه وحده .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from yunus Bin Yaqoub who said,  ‘It has reached me that Abu Abdullahasws would sometimes enter the bathhouse deliberately to wax hisasws armpit alone’.

t: Chapter 47 – The (Application of) the Henna after the Noura
ar: كان ابي موسي بن جعفر ( عليه السلام ) اذا اراد دخول الحمام امر ان يوقد له عليه ثلاثا و كان لا يمكنه دخوله حتي يدخله السودان فيلقون له اللبود فاذا دخله فمره قاعد و مره قايم فخرج يوما من الحمام فاستقبله رجل من ال الزبير يقال له كنيد و بيده اثر حناء فقال ما هذا الاثر بيدك فقال اثر حناء فقال ويلك يا كنيد حدثني ابي و كان اعلم اهل زمانه عن ابيه عن جده قال قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) من دخل الحمام فاطلي ثم اتبعه بالحناء من قرنه الي قدمه كان امانا له من الجنون و الجذام و البرص و الاكله الي مثله من النوره.
en: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar and Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Is’haq Al Ahmar,  (It has been narrated) from Al-Husayn son of Musaasws who said, ‘My fatherasws Musaasws Bin Ja’farasws, whenever heasws wanted to enter the bathhouse, ordered that it should be ignited for him with three (people) being over it, and heasws would not enter it until the slaves enter it and they would be laying down the matting for him. So when heasws entered it, (into the bath) heasws would be seated for a while, and standing for a while.   So one day heasws came out from the bathhouse, and a man from the progeny of Al-Zubeyr called Kuneyd met himasws, and in hisasws hands were the traces of henna. So he said, ‘What are these traces in yourasws hands?’ So heasws said: ‘Traces of henna. Woe be unto you O Kuneyd! Myasws fatherasws narrated to me, and heasws was the most knowledgeable of the people of hisasws time, from hisasws fatherasws, from hisasws grandfatherasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one who enters the bathhouse, so he waxes, then follows it up with the henna from his head to his feet, it would be a safety for him from the insanity, and the leprosy, and the vitiligo, and the corrosion to such like, from the Noura’.

t: Chapter 47 – The (Application of) the Henna after the Noura
ar: رايت ابا جعفر ( عليه السلام ) و قد اخذ الحناء و جعله علي اظافيره فقال يا حكم ما تقول في هذا فقلت ما عسيت ان اقول فيه و انت تفعله و ان عندنا يفعله الشبان فقال يا حكم ان الاظافير اذا اصابتها النوره غيرتها حتي تشبه اظافير الموتي فغيرها بالحناء .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Muawiya Bin Maysara, from Al Hakam Bin Uteyba who said,  ‘I saw Abu Ja’farasws and heasws had taken the henna and made it to be upon hisasws nails, so heasws said: ‘O Hakam! What are you saying regarding this?’ So I said, ‘What can I say and youasws have done it, and among us it is the youth who do it’. So heasws said: ‘O Hakam! When the nails are hit by the Noura, it changes them until they resemble the nails of the dead, therefore change it back by the henna’.

t: Chapter 47 – The (Application of) the Henna after the Noura
ar: من اطلي فتدلك بالحناء من قرنه الي قدمه نفي عنه الفقر .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of our companions, raising it,  ‘Heasws said: ‘The one who waxes and massages with the henna from his head to his feet, the poverty is negated from him’.

t: Chapter 47 – The (Application of) the Henna after the Noura
ar: رايت ابا جعفر ( عليه السلام ) و قد خرج من الحمام و هو من قرنه الي قدمه مثل الورده من اثر الحناء .
en: From him, from Ahmad Bin Ubdous Bin Ibrahim who said,  ‘I saw Abu Ja’farasws and heasws had come out from the bathhouse, and heasws was like the rose from hisasws head to hisasws feet, from the effects of the henna’.

t: Chapter 47 – The (Application of) the Henna after the Noura
ar: كان ابو الحسن ( عليه السلام ) مع رجل عند قبر رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) فنظر اليه و قد اخذ الحناء من يديه فقال بعض اهل المدينه ا ما ترون الي هذا كيف اخذ الحناء من يديه فالتفت اليه فقال له فيه ما تخبره و ما لا تخبره ثم التفت الي فقال انه من اخذ من الحناء بعد فراغه من اطلاء النوره من قرنه الي قدمه امن من الادواء الثلاثه الجنون و الجذام و البرص .
en: Ali Bin Muhammad, form Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Ibrahim Bin Uqba, from Al Husayn Bin Musa who said,  ‘Abu Al-Hassanasws was with a man in the presence of the grave of Rasool-Allahsaww, so he looked at himasws and heasws had applied henna upon hisasws hands. So one of the people of Al-Medina said, ‘Are you not looking at this one how heasws has applied the henna upon hisasws hands?’ So heasws turned towards him and said to him: ‘In it is what you are informed of and what you are not informed of’. Then heasws turned towards me, so heasws said: ‘The one who takes from the henna after him having been freed from the waxing of the Noura, from his head to his feet, is safe from three illnesses – the insanity, and the leprosy, and the vitiligo’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: الطيب من اخلاق الانبياء .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws having said: ‘The perfume is from the etiquettes of the Prophetsas’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: العطر من سنن المرسلين .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Abu Asama,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The perfume is from the Sunnah of the Mursil Prophetsas’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: كنت عند ابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) و انا مع ابي بصير فسمعت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) و هو يقول قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) ان الريح الطيبه تشد القلب و تزيد في الجماع .
en: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Ra’ib who said,  ‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullahasws and I was with Abu Baseer, so I heard Abu Abdullahasws and heasws was saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The fragrance of the perfume strengthens the heart and increases in the copulation’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: لا ينبغي للرجل ان يدع الطيب في كل يوم فان لم يقدر عليه فيوم و يوم لا فان لم يقدر ففي كل جمعه و لا يدع .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Moamar Bin Khallad,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassanasws having said: ‘It is not befitting for the man that he should leave the perfume during each day, so if he is not able over it, so a day and a day (alternate days), so if he is not able, so during every Friday, and he should not leave it’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: قال امير المومنين ( عليه السلام ) الطيب في الشارب من اخلاق النبيين ( عليهم السلام ) و كرامه للكاتبين .
en: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The perfume in the moustache is from the mannerisms of the Prophetsas and a prestige for the two scribes (Recording Angels)’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) قال رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) الطيب يشد القلب .
en: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from sa’dan, from Abu Baseer who said,  ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The perfume strengthens the heart’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: من تطيب اول النهار لم يزل عقله معه الي الليل و قال قال ابو عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) صلاه متطيب افضل من سبعين صلاه بغير طيب .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim,  (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who applies perfume at the inception of the day his intellect would not cease to be with him up to the night’.  And he (the narrator) said: ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘A Salaat (Prayer) performed whilst perfumed is superior than seventy Salaat without perfuming’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: سمعت ابي يقول العطر من سنن المرسلين .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali,  (It has been narrated) from Al-Abbas son of Musaasws who said, ‘I heard my fatherasws saying: ‘The perfume is from the Sunnah of the Mursil Prophetsas’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: ثلاث اعطيهن الانبياء ( عليهم السلام ) العطر و الازواج و السواك .
en: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd,  (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Three (things) are which the Prophetsas came to – the perfume, and the wives, and the brushing of teeth’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: سمعت ابا عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) يقول حق علي كل محتلم في كل جمعه اخذ شاربه و اظفاره و مس شي‏ء من الطيب و كان رسول الله ( صلي الله عليه واله ) اذا كان يوم الجمعه و لم يكن عنده طيب دعا ببعض خمر نسايه فبلها بالماء ثم وضعها علي وجهه .
en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhamad Bin Musa Bin Al Furat, from Ali Bin Matar, form Al Sakan Al Khazzaz who said,  ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘It is a right upon every adolescent male during every Friday that he takes from his moustache, and his nails, and touches himself with something from the perfume; and Rasool-Allahsaww, whenever it was the day of Friday, and there did not happen to be a perfume with himsaww, would call for a scarf of one of hissaww wives, so hesaww would moisten it with the water, then place it upon hissaww face’.

t: Chapter 48 – The Perfume
ar: كان يعرف موضع سجود ابي عبد الله ( عليه السلام ) بطيب ريحه .
